title: POST /api/projects/:id/todos — create to-do
description: Create a new to-do item for a project with optional milestone linkage. Triggers progress recalculation.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
sort_order defaults to end of list

steps.description: Create todo Zod schema and handler
steps.details: createTodoSchema = z.object({ title: z.string().min(1).max(500), milestoneId: z.string().uuid().optional(), dueDate: z.string().date().optional(), isUrgent: z.boolean().optional() }). Handler: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) If milestoneId provided, verify it belongs to same project. 3) Find max sort_order. 4) Insert todo. 5) Call recalculateProgress(projectId). 6) Return 201.
Create server/src/routes/todos.ts with mergeParams: true. Mount: app.use('/api/projects/:id/todos', requireAuth, todosRouter).
Create 3 todos — verify sort_orders 1, 2, 3. Create with milestoneId — verify linked. Progress should still be 0% (none completed).
